spacing-before.$description: Incoming spacing request when a thematic break follows another direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap is the larger of this spacing-before and the previous treatment's spacing-after, so structural hierarchy wins without relying on source order.

spacing-after.$description: Outgoing spacing request contributed by a thematic break to the next direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap is the larger of this spacing-after and the next treatment's spacing-before; documented compound pairs may intentionally use the tighter outgoing gap.

color.$description: Color of a prose thematic break.

width.$description: Block-axis thickness of a prose thematic break.

style.$description: Line style of a prose thematic break.
